prompt: What is the name of the small town near which the Douglas C-47A ZS-EJK, operated by Comair Ltd, crashed into a mountain in October 1982?
answer: The Douglas C-47A ZS-EJK crashed near **Graskop**, in what was then the Eastern Transvaal (now Mpumalanga), South Africa.
